acip: GAL TE DE NYON MONGS YIN NA, SGRIB PA YIN DGOS PAS, DE YIN NA RANG GI NGO BO'I SGO NAS BYANG CHUB SGRUB PA LA BAR DU GCOD BYED YIN PA'I PHYIR DE'I RGYUR 'GYUR BA 'GAL LO ZHE NA,
wylie: gal te de nyon mongs yin na, sgrib pa yin dgos pas, de yin na rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod byed yin pa'i phyir de'i rgyur 'gyur ba 'gal lo zhe na
english: One may continue with the following objection: "If something is a mental affliction, then it's necessarily an obstacle to spiritual progress.  And if it's an obstacle like this, then it must be something that, by its very nature, hinders our quest for enlightenment.  And in this case it would be a contradiction to say it were a cause for this enlightenment."
